tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read the complete contents of a file from the local filesystem.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Create a new file or overwrite an existing file with the given contents.

tools.name: edit_file
tools.description: Apply a line-based edit to an existing text file on disk.

tools.name: list_directory
tools.description: List the files and subdirectories within a local directory.

tools.name: create_directory
tools.description: Create a new directory, including any missing parent directories.

tools.name: move_file
tools.description: Move or rename a file or directory on the local filesystem.

tools.name: delete_file
tools.description: Delete a file from the local filesystem.

tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Recursively search for files matching a glob pattern under a directory.

tools.name: get_file_info
tools.description: Get metadata for a file such as size and modification time.
